## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `45763c74fa470b9e277be741ddf87d0366ca78c1`
Local-runs: probe — `check-half-states.mjs --self-test` on the head plus two ablation legs (restored, `git diff` empty) and a read-only clause probe over eight candidate mixes, because the card's acceptance item 1 is a behavioural claim about the H4 prose clause that no check-run prints; the skill ratchet, skill-id lint and token ratchet were run read-only beside it
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (:110, the `pm:blocked` status row), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md (:252, the unlock-scan line) + scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (`namedProseCandidates` :2356, `proseBlockerClause` :2395-2450, `blockerResolutionFromRow` :5152, `h19BlockOutlivedBlocker` :5434-5515, `h28StaleBodyBlockerLine` :7640-7660, H4 prose PR pins :25023-25037); read but not reviewed: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md :22-:27, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md :85, scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs (`staleBlockVerdict` :571, `targetReading` :641, `renderBlockNote` :660)

### ① Derived judgments

Base is `origin/main` at `3f02da10f` (merge base; the branch is the single commit `45763c74f`). `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28031` on the head: 2 of 3 paths hit the register, both `.claude/**`, Tier S; `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` is not on the register; size 55 lines. The register and the PR body agree. Every claim the diff makes, judged against the tree and by running it:

1. H4 prose half, the resolver contract. `blockerResolutionFromRow` (:5152) keeps `state: 'closed'` for a PR row whose `pull_request.merged_at` is null and adds `unmerged: true`; an issue row (no `pull_request` key) and a merged PR carry no mark. Confirmed by running it on the three row shapes (the probe prints the rows). The clause's new buckets are built on exactly that field: `closed` is now `state === 'closed' && unmerged !== true`, `abandoned` is `state === 'closed' && unmerged === true`, and `open` is read explicitly instead of as the remainder. TRUE as the PR body states.
2. The three directions the card asks for, driven at the head through the sweep's own projection (`blockerResolutionFromRow`) and read off the rendered clause:
   - a prose-named MERGED PR (#27888 shape): list line `#27888 CLOSED (closed_at)`, verdict `Every one of them is ALREADY CLOSED … due back in pm:queue`. Released, as before.
   - a prose-named CLOSED-UNMERGED PR (#27296 shape): list line `#27296 CLOSED UNMERGED (closed_at)`, verdict `Every one of them is a PR that closed UNMERGED — an abandoned attempt releases nothing … the block still stands; the target wants re-pointing`. `due back` absent, `ALREADY CLOSED` absent. NOT released.
   - a closed ISSUE: identical to the merged-PR reading, `due back in pm:queue` present. Issues still release on closed as before.
   - abandoned beside open: `None of them has released — 1 still reads OPEN, 1 closed UNMERGED (which withholds)`; abandoned beside unresolved; abandoned beside unresolved beside open: same shape, counts right, no `ALREADY CLOSED`, no `due back`.
   - merged beside abandoned, and closed-issue beside abandoned: `1 of 2 is ALREADY CLOSED — the block is at least partly expired`; only the merge or issue close is counted, the abandoned one is named `CLOSED UNMERGED` on the list line.
   Branch order: the all-closed and partly-closed branches come first and now see only true releases, so the all-abandoned branch can only fire when no row released; the all-open branch is now explicit, so an abandoned row beside an open one no longer reads `They all still read OPEN` (the base's remainder bucket would have said exactly that). Every direction the card's item 1 names holds.
3. The pins pin it. `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` on the committed head: exit 0, 5098 cases (was 5089; nine new `H4 prose PR:` pins, matching the PR body). Ablation at the head, each leg restored with `git checkout` and `git diff --stat` empty afterwards: (A) the `closed` filter back to `state === 'closed'` → exit 1, 6 of 5098 red, all six the new pins (`NOT released`, `never says due back`, `re-point not release`, `neither an expiry nor all-open`, `never counts the unmerged close as expired`, `only the merge as expired`); (C) the all-abandoned branch deleted → exit 1, 1 red (`re-point, not release`). The seat's reported counts (A: 6, C: 1) reproduce exactly. The two merged-PR pins and the closed-issue pins are the control direction and stay green under both legs, as the seat said. Leg B (dropping the `UNMERGED` word) was not re-run here; the seat's 1-red reading is consistent with pin `names the candidate with its unmerged mark`, which is the only pin that reads the list line.
4. Report-only holds. `proseBlockerClause` returns a string that H4 appends to its finding; no label write, no new exit code, and the clause still ends with `fix it by writing the Blocked-by: #N line whatever the states above say`. H19 (:5434-5435) already excluded `unmerged` from `closed` and renders `closed UNMERGED` before this PR; H26 (:7264) still asks its question of open targets only; H28 (:7652) is untouched. No new gate anywhere in the diff.
5. SKILL.md :110, the `pm:blocked` row. Old: 「#N 关闭时由解锁扫描或 `scheduled-full-run-card.yml` 刷新放回」. New: 「#N 关单(PR 则合并,关而未合并不放)时由解锁扫描或 `scheduled-full-run-card.yml` 放回」. True against the code: the unlock scan's reader H19 founds nothing on an unmerged PR and the refresh's `staleBlockVerdict` (scheduled-full-run.mjs :571-583) answers `held` on any `unmerged` row and `expired` only when every target merged or closed as an issue. True against state-machine.md :24 「合并才放,关而未合并 ⛔ 不放」 and consistent with :27 「上游已关 ⇒ 先重新推导是否有新阻塞并改写该行,⛔ 不反射式放行」, which the old row did not contradict either (the row names who puts the card back; :27 names what the seat does first). The four in-row payments: 「刷新放回」→「放回」 (the yml still refreshes; the verb that matters is kept); 「工已完、PR 被外部门禁卡住的」→「工已完而被门禁卡住的」 (now the same words as state-machine.md :23 「工已完而被门禁缺陷卡住者同用本态」, nothing dropped); 「正文或线程行首」→「双通道行首」 (the term SKILL.md :126 and platform-readings.md :251 already use for body-or-comment); 「挂本态直至其」→「直至其」 (the row IS the state, so the subject is implied). No rule dropped. Line count 319 → 319 (`wc -l` on head and on `3f02da10f`); the row is 341 bytes at the head (336 on base), and `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` reads `SKILL.md: widest table row is 341 bytes (pin 341; headroom 0)` and `319 lines (ceiling 319)`, exit 0.
6. platform-readings.md :252. Old: 「解锁扫描 `list_issues` 列卡、`issue_read` 直读目标,⛔ 不加常设评论读;PR 判合并读 `merged_at`。」 New: 「解锁扫描 `list_issues` 列卡、逐目标直读,⛔ 不加常设评论读;PR 合并走 `pull_request_read`/REST。」 True against measurement 6516593752: MCP `issue_read` on a PR number answers `state: closed` with no `pull_request` key and no `merged_at` on both #27296 (abandoned) and #27888 (merged), so the old line named a read that cannot make the distinction it claimed; `pull_request_read get` answers `merged`, and REST `GET /issues/N` carries `pull_request.merged_at`, which is the field `blockerResolutionFromRow` and scheduled-full-run.mjs :623 read. The line is 120 bytes at the head (`MAX_LINE_BYTES` 120, the ratchet reads platform-readings.md at 458 lines, ceiling 458, exit 0); line count 458 → 458. The seat's declared deviation (the line cannot also say `never issue_read` within 120 bytes) is accepted: `issue_read` is excluded by omission and `pull_request_read` is a term the same file already uses (:61, :230).
7. Skill text hygiene. `node scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs --self-test` then the lint: 105 files clean against `/#[0-9]{3,}/g`, exit 0; a grep of the two edited files for `#` followed by three or more digits finds nothing. `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: 56 authored bundle files within ceilings, exit 0. Both `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` map (package.json :75-76) to the two scripts run above with `--self-test` first, and both run without an install.
8. Agreement with triage 6516946612. The ruling: no new gate; an abandoned PR target is flagged by the patrol and re-pointed by triage, not held silently; at most the `pm:blocked` row says so. The diff does exactly that: the row says 「关而未合并不放」, the H4 clause names the abandoned target and says 「the target wants re-pointing (to the PR's card, or to the queue with a note)」, state-machine.md and H26 are untouched, H28 is untouched (card item 5 conditions it on touching H28). Items 4 and 5 are read, not edited, as the PR body states.
9. Scope. The diff touches the three files the claim's file surface names and nothing else; state-machine.md, named as conditional in the claim, is untouched. PR body: `Fixes #27989` on the first content line, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; label `skip-changeset` is right for PM tooling and skill text with no published package.
10. Not measured here: ESLint on the touched script (no node_modules in the worktree or the checkout); the `Lint · ESLint` check-run on the head is success. The seat's 58-command gate reconciliation is read, not re-run.

### ② Semver level

No published package is touched (`.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only); `skip-changeset` carried. `Clause-②: no` is right; no narrowing declared or present.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Served tier versus face: the register answers Tier S on two `.claude/**` paths, so the governed rules-text face applies and this record is served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, the tier the queue guard will read.
- Author: PR `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (attribution comment names os-elon-musk); no non-bot login to record.
- Contract-review-claim: comment 6519369559 names the seat session and this head; no competing claim, no hold, no hand-off.
- CI at review time (second poll, 45 check runs on `45763c74`): success on Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · CI release & engine gates, the three Lint · scoped jobs, TypeScript Type Check and its four sub-jobs, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test UI, Test Core (2/8), Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Live required-set sweep, Platform checklist gate sweep, Release section-coverage sweep, board snapshot, Auto Label, filter, Plan Test Core shards; still in_progress: Test Core (1/8), Live half-state sweep; the rest skipped by path filter. No failure. The final all-green reading is the landing gate's.
- Seat report deviations: (a) the 120-byte line names `pull_request_read`/REST and not `never issue_read`, accepted in ①.6; (b) assignment and review request skipped at PR creation per SKILL.md 「`pr_create` 不请不派」, accepted; (c) state-machine.md untouched per triage, accepted in ①.8.
- Premise: `premise_still_valid: true`; base `3f02da10f` still carried 「#N 关闭时」 at SKILL.md :110 and `issue_read` + `merged_at` at platform-readings.md :252 (read off `git show`).
- Open edge, not blocking: with only abandoned and unresolved rows (no open one) the mixed branch prints `0 still read OPEN, …`; counts right, verdict right, wording slightly odd (should-fix 4).
- Draft PR, `mergeable_state: blocked`; Tier S landing by the owning seat after this record and all-green.

### ④ Design judgment

Rules face, per `hits` file:

- SKILL.md :110. The row is the one place the status table states when a `pm:blocked` card comes back, and it was false for a PR target the moment PR #27983 let a `Blocked-by:` line name a PR. The edit puts the merged-not-closed rule where a dispatching seat reads it first, in six characters of parenthesis, and pays for them inside the same row rather than by widening the ceiling. Against the code it cites (the unlock scan and the full-run refresh) the sentence is now exactly what both readers do, and against state-machine.md :24 it is the same rule in the short form. The payments are the right kind: two are the state-machine's own phrasing, one is a term the file already defines by reference, one drops a subject the row itself supplies. Holds.
- platform-readings.md :252. The old line taught a read that the measurement shows cannot answer the question (MCP `issue_read` flattens a merged and an abandoned PR to `closed`), which is the worse failure for a rules line: a seat following it would judge release on a field the tool does not return. The new line names the two reads that do return it and stops naming the tool, which is the right fix at this byte budget: the ⛔ against `issue_read` would be a rule about one tool's shape, and the file's convention (:61, :228-:230) is to record such shapes as measured legs, not as prohibitions. Holds; a later line stating the `issue_read` leg as a measured reading (the way :228-:230 do for labels) would make the omission explicit (should-fix 3).
- The code half (not a `hits` file, read as the gate the rule names): the clause's bucket change is minimal and fail-closed in the one direction that matters, an abandoned PR never reads as released, and it is pinned from the API row shape rather than from a hand-built row, so a change to the resolver's `unmerged` contract would break these pins too. No new gate, no label write, consistent with triage's ruling that the patrol flags and triage re-points.

Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Must-fix: none.

Should-fix:
1. .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md :85 「旗二:`pm:blocked` 卡的 `Blocked-by:` 目标已关闭。」 still describes the patrol's flag as `closed` for every target; for a PR target the flag fires on merged (H19 excludes an unmerged close). One in-line word, e.g. 「目标已关单(PR 则已合并)」, governed path, outside this card's file surface. Skills seat.
2. scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs `h28StaleBodyBlockerLine` :7652 and :7659 count an abandoned PR among `spent` and say `CLOSED` (card item 5). The verdict and remedy are right (the body line is stale either way, and `namedTargets` renders `closed UNMERGED`), so wording only; the card conditions it on a PR that touches H28, and this one does not. Rides later.
3. platform-readings.md: a measured-leg line for `issue_read` on a PR number (answers `state: closed`, no `pull_request`, no `merged_at`; measurement 6516593752) in the style of :228-:230, when the file has a line of headroom. Makes the :252 omission explicit instead of implicit.
4. `proseBlockerClause` mixed branch (:2435-2440): when `open.length` is 0 (abandoned beside unresolved only) the sentence opens `0 still read OPEN`. Drop the open clause when the count is zero. Cosmetic; counts and verdict are right.
5. scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs `renderBlockNote` :661-663 renders every resolution as `(closed …)` in the body note; only reachable at verdict `expired` or `assigned`, where `staleBlockVerdict` has already excluded any unmerged row, so a merged PR is rendered `closed`: true, imprecise. Outside scripts/pm, noted for the same follow-up as 2.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`Blocked-by:` 指向的是 PR 时，三处读器改成「合并才放行」，PR 关闭但没合并不放行。三处是：
  - H4 散文部分：把「关闭但未合并」单列一类，显示 `CLOSED UNMERGED`，也不再提示「due back in pm:queue」；
  - SKILL.md:110 的 `pm:blocked` 行；
  - platform-readings.md:252：判断 PR 是否合并改用 `pull_request_read` 或 REST，不再用 `issue_read`。

  共 3 个文件。规则文本两处行数不变（319、458）。
- 为什么改：PR #27983 之后，`Blocked-by:` 可以写 PR，规则是合并才放行。但这三处仍按「关闭」来判，会把挂在废弃 PR 上的卡报成「该回队」。实测 MCP `issue_read` 分不出合并和废弃（6516593752）。
- 风险与回滚：只改 report-only 的行文和规则文本，不加门禁，也不写标签。issue 类目标仍是关闭即放行，行为不变。回滚就是 revert。
- 先看：`check-half-states.mjs` 的 `proseBlockerClause`，它新增了 `abandoned` 一类，并加了 9 个钉子。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`，5098 例，exit 0。
- 需要你做的：无。登记册判定为 Tier S（`.claude/**` ×2）。契约复核 PASS，记录在本评论之前，`Head-sha: 45763c74fa470b9e277be741ddf87d0366ca78c1`。本席转 ready 并开自动合并。

席位意见：ACCEPT。契约复核 PASS，没有 must-fix。复核亲自做了两条消融，都按预期变红，复原后 diff 为空：
- 让「已关闭」一类也算未合并的 PR：6 个新钉子变红；
- 去掉「全部废弃」的分支：1 个变红。

should-fix 1、2、4、5 都只是措辞，不影响判定，转到跟进卡 #28033。这四处还把 PR 目标说成「关闭」：
- dispatch-runbook.md:85 旗二；
- H28；
- H4 混合行；
- 定时全量运行的备注。

should-fix 3（给 `issue_read` 补一条实测行）作为该卡的可选项。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** one PR, `Fixes #27989`, three files: `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`. `skip-changeset`. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28031`: Tier S (`.claude/**` ×2; `check-half-states.mjs` is not on the register).
- **前提实测:** `blockerResolutionFromRow` marks `unmerged: true` only on a closed PR with a null `merged_at`. H19 already excludes `unmerged`, and `staleBlockVerdict` holds on any unmerged row, so the new row text is true against the code and matches `state-machine.md:24`. The review probed eight candidate mixes at the head: a merged PR is released, a closed-unmerged PR reads `CLOSED UNMERGED` with no "due back", and a closed issue is released as before.
- **门禁 check-runs:** head `45763c74fa470b9e277be741ddf87d0366ca78c1`: 51 check-runs, 30 success, 20 skipped, 0 failed, 1 still running (Live half-state sweep or Test Core 1/8); auto-merge waits on it. Locally: skill line ratchet, token ratchet and skill-id lint (105 files) all exit 0; 58 of 58 derived gate families exit 0 (dev report).
- **接受的偏差:** none. `state-machine.md` and H28 are untouched, as triage 6516946612 ruled (no new gate; item 4 is wording at most).
- **范围外去向:** #28033 (`pm:blocked` on this PR) takes review should-fixes 1–5.
- **落地条款:** Tier S: on the contract review PASS on the current head, the seat posts the record and this ACCEPT, flips it ready and arms auto-merge, under the maintainer's landing grant for this term (seat thread, 2026-10-29 22:04Z).
